name: inspect_apk_signature
description: Inspect declared v1/v2/v3/v3.1 APK signers, certificate fingerprints, algorithm IDs, content digests, SDK ranges, rotation lineage and source stamp without executing Android code. SHA-256 identifies the exact local file. Summary retains complete Evidence; an optional view selects signers/digests/lineage using stable IDs, scheme or signer-ID batches, fields and paging. Read retained pages with inspect_analysis_view kind apk-signature after the source is removed. IDs include artifact digest, scheme and source ordinal; certificates retain raw-DER SHA-256. Content-digest equality is not cryptographic signature verification: modified declarations can match modified bytes. Authenticity, signatures, lineage trust and v1 entry coverage remain unverified. Malformed structures and resource refusals are explicit; no device, network or SDK is used by REA.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.
